title: Adversarial CI Forged Object & Observable Execution Test Matrix

groups.name: Adversarial Forged Caller Objects & Cryptographic Attestation Boundary

vectors.name: Handcrafted proof with trusted source/verifier but no attestation token
vectors.attackVector: Caller supplies object with source='GITHUB_API', verifier='SWAI_TRUSTED_GITHUB_VERIFIER_V1', verified=true, 64-char digest, matching SHA, but attestationToken=undefined
vectors.expectedBehavior: verifyAuthenticCiProof returns status='CI_CLAIM_UNVERIFIED', ciProviderVerified=false, verified=false

vectors.name: Handcrafted proof with forged/invalid HMAC token
vectors.attackVector: Caller provides random HMAC-like 64-hex string as attestationToken
vectors.expectedBehavior: verifyAuthenticCiProof detects cryptographic signature mismatch, returns CI_CLAIM_UNVERIFIED

vectors.name: Token replay attack with different commit SHA
vectors.attackVector: Attacker captures valid token for commit SHA_X and attempts to replay it against commit SHA_Y
vectors.expectedBehavior: verifyAuthenticCiProof detects payload SHA binding mismatch and rejects fail-closed

vectors.name: Token parameter tampering with altered runId
vectors.attackVector: Attacker modifies runId while keeping valid token for original runId
vectors.expectedBehavior: verifyCiAttestationToken returns false due to signature invalidation; verification rejected

vectors.name: Token parameter tampering with altered status/conclusion
vectors.attackVector: Attacker changes run conclusion from 'failure' to 'success' using token minted for 'failure'
vectors.expectedBehavior: Cryptographic signature check fails; returns status='CI_CLAIM_UNVERIFIED'

vectors.name: Mock/test actor signature rejection
vectors.attackVector: Caller supplies token minted with actor='UNIT_TEST_MOCK_ACTOR' in production validation mode
vectors.expectedBehavior: verifyAuthenticCiProof quarantines mock actor and refuses elevation to commercial CI_PASS

vectors.name: verifyRemoteGitHubActionsRun dependency-injected mock stamping
vectors.attackVector: Caller passes customFetch to simulate successful GitHub API response
vectors.expectedBehavior: Function stamps isUnitTestMock=true, source='UNIT_TEST_MOCK', and marks mint token with isMock=true

groups.name: Unit Test Mock Quarantine in Commercial Release Gates

vectors.name: evaluateReleaseGatesV19 demotes mock-verified CI run to CI_NOT_RUN
vectors.attackVector: CI status passed to evaluateReleaseGatesV19 has runStatus='SUCCESS' but isUnitTestMock=true
vectors.expectedBehavior: Evaluator demotes ciStatus to CI_NOT_RUN, adds CI_CLAIM_UNVERIFIED blocker, overallReleaseAllowed=false

vectors.name: validateVerifiedCiAttestation rejects attestation marked isUnitTestMock: true
vectors.attackVector: Attestation object has isUnitTestMock=true and source='UNIT_TEST_MOCK'
vectors.expectedBehavior: Validator returns valid=false, reason='MOCK_CI_EVIDENCE_CANNOT_SATISFY_COMMERCIAL_RELEASE'

vectors.name: verifyGitHubActionsRunProof rejects mock with requireTrustedVerifier: true
vectors.attackVector: Proof object marked isUnitTestMock passed to verifyGitHubActionsRunProof
vectors.expectedBehavior: Returns verified=false, reason='MOCK_CI_EVIDENCE_CANNOT_SATISFY_COMMERCIAL_RELEASE'

vectors.name: Handcrafted proof directly submitted to evaluateReleaseGatesV19 fails closed
vectors.attackVector: Handcrafted proof without signature submitted directly to release gate evaluator
vectors.expectedBehavior: Evaluator demotes status to CI_NOT_RUN with blocker CI_CLAIM_UNVERIFIED

vectors.name: Attestation with altered token payload parameters fails closed
vectors.attackVector: Attestation object altered post-minting (e.g. branch or event modified)
vectors.expectedBehavior: verifyCiAttestationToken fails cryptographic digest verification; proof rejected

groups.name: E9 Observable Execution and Candidate Database Readback Proof

vectors.name: runCandidateDbReadback script exists and is executable
vectors.attackVector: Verification that checked-in script exists at scripts/kh02/runCandidateDbReadback.ts
vectors.expectedBehavior: File exists, has non-zero size, and compiles cleanly with TypeScript

vectors.name: E9 script emits valid JSON to stdout
vectors.attackVector: Executing script and parsing stdout as JSON
vectors.expectedBehavior: stdout contains valid JSON object with status indicator; exit code is 0

vectors.name: E9 JSON contains mandatory candidate and database fields
vectors.attackVector: Checking schema of E9 stdout JSON
vectors.expectedBehavior: Contains candidateId, canonicalProductId, rawRecordCount, distinctKeywords, sourceClassifications, g15Verdict, g16Verdict

vectors.name: E9 reports dbConnected: true and rawRecordCount >= 0
vectors.attackVector: Querying live SQLite database (dev.db)
vectors.expectedBehavior: dbConnected=true, rawRecordCount=6

vectors.name: E9 honestly reports 0 businessAttributableCount and INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
vectors.attackVector: Running filterAttributableObservations with evaluationScope='BUSINESS'
vectors.expectedBehavior: businessAttributableCount=0, verifiedOfficialCsvRows=0, g15Verdict='INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE', g16Verdict='INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE'

vectors.name: E9 masks database credentials in stdout
vectors.attackVector: Testing DSN masking logic with sensitive credentials (e.g. postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db)
vectors.expectedBehavior: Password and user info are masked with '***'; credentials never leaked to stdout or logs

groups.name: E10 Remote CI Proof Diagnostic and Observable Proof

vectors.name: runRemoteCiProofDiagnostic script exists and is executable
vectors.attackVector: Verification that checked-in script exists at scripts/kh02/runRemoteCiProofDiagnostic.ts
vectors.expectedBehavior: File exists, has non-zero size, and compiles cleanly with TypeScript

vectors.name: E10 script emits valid JSON to stdout
vectors.attackVector: Executing script and parsing stdout as JSON
vectors.expectedBehavior: stdout contains valid JSON object with status indicator; exit code is 0

vectors.name: E10 JSON contains mandatory CI diagnostic fields
vectors.attackVector: Checking schema of E10 stdout JSON
vectors.expectedBehavior: Contains status, remoteVerificationLevel, ciProviderVerified, repository, branch, testedCodeSha

vectors.name: E10 reports status: 'CI_NOT_CONFIGURED' when no workflow/token is active
vectors.attackVector: Running without external GitHub Actions credentials or runId
vectors.expectedBehavior: Honestly outputs status='CI_NOT_CONFIGURED', remoteVerificationLevel='CI_NOT_RUN', ciProviderVerified=false

vectors.name: E10 with mock credentials stamps isUnitTestMock: true
vectors.attackVector: Invoking verifyRemoteGitHubActionsRun with mock handler
vectors.expectedBehavior: Outputs isUnitTestMock=true, preventing mock from satisfying commercial release

vectors.name: Complete release gate evaluation with honest inputs yields ENGINEERING_PASS and NO-GO
vectors.attackVector: evaluateReleaseGatesV19 with all 10 gates passed locally but no external CI and insufficient candidate history
vectors.expectedBehavior: engineeringStatus='PASS', releaseDecision='NO-GO', blockers include commercial and CI reasons

vectors.name: Attempted commercial elevation of dev/holdout data fails closed
vectors.attackVector: Feeding test fixtures or backtest synthetic series into commercial gate evaluator
vectors.expectedBehavior: Rejected with INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; commercial gating remains fail-closed

vectors.name: Point-in-time timestamp tampering fails verification
vectors.attackVector: Observation records dated after evaluation cutoff date
vectors.expectedBehavior: Point-in-time filter drops future observations strictly

vectors.name: Multi-stage pipeline prevents cross-candidate leakage
vectors.attackVector: Attempting to attribute Cat Feeder demand to KittySpout or Spin Scrubber candidate
vectors.expectedBehavior: Candidate boundary filter enforces exact candidate productId match; cross-attribution = 0

vectors.name: Full attestation chain enforces unforgeable proof boundary
vectors.attackVector: Injecting unsigned or corrupted attestation objects at any stage of the pipeline
vectors.expectedBehavior: Every pipeline stage verifies signature independently and fails closed
